features: 🍰You can fill the ice cube mold with fruits, ice cream, soda and wine to customize your favorite flavor. It’s safe to touch food or drink directly, and effective in freezing liquids like fruit juice, soup, and even baby food.

🧊NICE SMALL ICE CUBE TRAYS: A must-have mini tiny ice tray, make ice once and run out once.
